context: A boss and his manager review a multi-prefecture roadshow
purpose: Teach: 乗客/運賃/航空機/住居/富山/青森/秋田/茨城

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今回の地方キャラバン、どうだった?
lines.en: How did the regional caravan go this time?
lines.style: Authoritative boss opening with a short open-ended question.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: おかげさまで好評でした。ただ、富山に向かう航空機が遅延して、現地入りがぎりぎりでしたね。
lines.en: It went over well, thankfully. But the flight to Toyama was delayed, so we barely made it on time.
lines.style: Polite middle-manager tone with factual reporting and mild concern.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: そうか。天候のせいか?それで、秋田と茨城のほうはどうだ?
lines.en: I see. Was it the weather? And how about Akita and Ibaraki?
lines.style: Boss probing with a natural follow-up before pivoting to other regions.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 秋田の温泉地で開いた説明会は満員でした。茨城県の会場は狭くて、立ち見が出るほどです。乗客の安全面でも少し心配しました。
lines.en: The session at the Akita hot spring area was packed. The Ibaraki venue was too small and people had to stand. I was a bit worried about attendee safety too.
lines.style: Enthusiastic factual update with concrete turnout details and a safety note.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 立ち見か。次は会場を広く取ろう。それと、参加者の交通費、特に運賃の補助はどうしている?
lines.en: Standing room only, huh. Let's book bigger venues next time. And what are we doing about attendee travel costs, particularly fare subsidies?
lines.style: Boss pivoting to logistics and weighing budget concerns aloud.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 半額補助でやっています。富山からの方が一番遠かったので、その分だけ全額にしました。
lines.en: We're subsidizing half. Folks coming from Toyama had the longest trip, so we covered theirs in full.
lines.style: Steady operational answer showing thoughtful adjustment for distance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 妥当だな。あと、青森の山田から長期出張中の住居の件で相談が来ている。確認しておいてくれ。
lines.en: Reasonable. Also, Yamada in Aomori brought up something about housing during the long assignment. Look into it.
lines.style: Boss closing with a delegated follow-up task in businesslike tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。今週中に見積もりも合わせて報告いたします。
lines.en: Understood. I'll report back this week with the estimate as well.
lines.style: Formal subordinate confirmation closing the meeting politely.
